subject: Hmm indeed
author: Executioner_UK
body:
Define your perception of a sim and i'll check back here on the games release. To quote "A key part of EA's overall vision for SHIFT is to remove the grind often associated with sim racers" You are going to able to tweak the set up sure but it wont be a sim! Forza 3 yes, NFS no. If NFS Shift were to come anywhere near being a sim i for one would be in racing heaven but i aint gonna fool myself.

subject: No its not
author: Executioner_UK
body:
Shift a simulation? Youre not serious right? Take PGR, mix in a dollop of GRiD, simmer for 20 mins and you get Need For Speed: Shift. Its about as arcade as they come. High speed 60fps bumper to bumper racing. Nothing more, nothing less 🤔

subject: Pass on Shift
author: Chu
body:
NFS: Shift is a simulation game, so I doubt you'll like that Zomb. You next best bet on a new racing game in my opinion would be Blur and Split/Second, both of which won't be out for a while.

If I have the money, I'll be getting Forza 3 myself later this year. It too is a simulation, but it makes things really easy and unnecessary to know much about cars. All you need to be is good at driving the way a simulation racer wants you to.

subject: More FUEL reviews...
author: ZombieTron
body:
HERE is IGN's offering, they particularly mention how there is no reward for 2nd place, I really disliked this about Paradise, all previous Burnouts gave rewards for finishing in the top 3 Medal positions, having a game which is just win or lose is very disheartening to me. Although Paradise events were all pretty easy, and it seems like the same can be said for FUEL, I would prefer a tougher challenge that rewards you for coming in the top 3.

And it gets even worse in Eurogamers review HERE.

I'm sure we will still give it a go ourselves and write our own review once we have. Til then tho, I am extremely dissapointed! 🙁

EDIT - I am getting more and more put off from getting this game, which is a real shame as I thought it had a lot of promise. If you are still thinking about getting this game I would now have to recommend renting it first as it seems like it really could be that bad. 👎
